mapper.select: select execution_id, conversation_id, turn_id, user_id, question_hash, status, owner_token, attempt_count, lease_until, trace_id, result_payload, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, error_code, error_message, create_time, update_time from oc_ai_turn_execution where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and turn_id = #{turnId}
mapper.insert: insert into oc_ai_turn_execution ( conversation_id, turn_id, user_id, question_hash, status, owner_token, attempt_count, lease_until, trace_id, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{execution.conversationId}, #{execution.turnId}, #{execution.userId}, #{execution.questionHash}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.ownerToken}, #{execution.attemptCount}, date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), #{execution.traceId}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_ai_turn_execution set owner_token = #{ownerToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), trace_id = #{traceId}, error_code = null, error_message = null, update_time = sysdate() where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and turn_id = #{turnId} and question_hash = #{questionHash} and ( status = 'FAILED' or (status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until < sysdate()) )

update oc_ai_turn_execution set owner_token = #{ownerToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_until = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = sysdate() where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and turn_id = #{turnId} and status = 'PERSISTING' and lease_until < sysdate()

update oc_ai_turn_execution set status = 'PERSISTING', owner_token = #{ownerToken}, lease_until = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = sysdate() where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and turn_id = #{turnId} and status = 'READY'

update oc_ai_turn_execution set status = 'READY', result_payload = #{resultPayload}, error_code = null, error_message = null, lease_until = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = sysdate() where execution_id = #{executionId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and status = 'PROCESSING'

update oc_ai_turn_execution set status = 'SUCCEEDED', user_message_id = #{userMessageId}, assistant_message_id = #{assistantMessageId}, error_code = null, error_message = null, lease_until = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where execution_id = #{executionId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and status = 'PERSISTING'

update oc_ai_turn_execution set status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_until = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where execution_id = #{executionId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and status = 'PROCESSING'

update oc_ai_turn_execution set status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_until = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where execution_id = #{executionId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and status = 'PERSISTING'

update oc_ai_turn_execution set status = 'READY', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_until = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = sysdate() where execution_id = #{executionId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and status = 'PERSISTING'
